papers.title_en: A Missing Latent, Not a Missing Simulator: Radius-Augmented Inference for Real JWST Retrieval
papers.authors: Angshuman Chakravertty, P V V Raj
papers.evidence: JWST系外行星大气反演与成分推断
papers.tldr: 摊销模拟推断（SBI）在合成 JWST 光谱上表现准确，却在真实还原光谱上崩溃，此前多归咎于前向模型物理缺失。作者先用嵌套采样排除温度梯度、SO2 与高保真不透明度等因素，锁定真正缺失的隐变量是行星半径，并据此构建半径增广的流匹配后验 MIRAGE，用重要性采样与最优传输映射对齐嵌套采样参考。真实 WASP-39b 的 χ²/N 从 301 降至 0.06，方法无需改动即迁移到多个仪器与目标。教训是：模拟器已编码却被推断遗漏的隐变量会伪装成模型误设。
papers.abstract_en: Amortized simulation-based inference (SBI), which is trained on radiative-transfer simulators, recovers exoplanet atmospheres accurately on synthetic James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) spectra but collapses when it comes to real reduced spectra. The flow posterior collapsed on real WASP-39b (importance-sampling effective sample size (ESS) = 1, best-fit \c{hi}2/N = 301), and such a failure is usually blamed on missing the forward-model physics, but ruling these levers out with nested sampling first (a temperature gradient, SO2 opacity, and a high-fidelity opacity set) leaves the fit unchanged, meaning the collapse is not from the simulator misspecification but instead from a missing latent, the planet radius. To fix this, we build MIRAGE, a radius-augmented flow-matching posterior calibrated against an independent nested-sampling reference with importance sampling and an optimal-transport map, which yields a physical and literature-consistent retrieval of real WASP-39b (with \c{hi}2/N from 301 to 0.06). This same method transfers unchanged across two instruments and three real JWST targets, including one spectrum self-reduced end-to-end from raw Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes(MAST) data. The lesson is cross-domain, as a latent the simulator encodes but the inference omits can masquerade as misspecification.

papers.title_en: TOI-1408: the limb darkening models, photometric and Doppler noises, and the exoplanetary system
papers.evidence: 近2:1共振双行星系统的轨道构型与稳定性
papers.tldr: 1 平运动共振行星及一颗远伴星。本文自洽联合分析 Doppler、TESS 与地面凌星观测，并检验临边昏暗模型、光度与 Doppler 噪声。结果确认既有轨道构型，但发现似然函数存在多个局部极大，导致行星 b 半径仍仅约束在约 1.2–3.5 R_Jup。研究还表明恒星质量与半径先验对拟合影响显著，强调需精确刻画先验及其相关性。
papers.abstract_en: We perform a self-consistent analysis of Doppler and photometric TESS and ground-based transit observations available for TOI-1408, known to host a system with two planets orbiting near 2:1 mean-motion commensurability and a distant companion. In general we confirm its orbital configuration derived in previous studies, however we found that the likelihood function contains multiple local maxima spread over a wider parametric domain, thus making some model uncertainties significantly larger than deemed before. In particular, the planet b radius still appears poorly constrained (from $\sim 1.2$~$R_{\rm Jup}$ to $\sim 3.5$~$R_{\rm Jup}$) because of the near-tangential transit geometry. We also show that the derived model is very prior-dependent regarding the astrophysical (spectrum-derived) constraints on the stellar mass $M_\star$ and radius $R_\star$. While such estimations may potentially contribute a significant information to the fit, their prior distribution must be accurately specified to be useful. Presently so accurate characterization (e.g. the correlation between $M_\star$ and $R_\star$) is not available in the literature.

papers.title_en: The 200-300 GHz Survey for 18 Class II Disks in the Ophiuchus Star-Forming Complex
papers.authors: Chia-Ying Chung, Hauyu Baobab Liu, Chuan-Yung Lin, Linjing Feng, Sean M. Andrews, Mark A. Gurwell, Melvyn Wright
papers.evidence: 对II类原行星盘进行亚毫米波巡天并测量其光谱指数
papers.tldr: 为检验年轻星团中Class II原行星盘的尘埃发射是否普遍偏光学厚，研究用SMA测量蛇夫座18个盘的198–310 GHz流量并拟合约200–300 GHz谱指数α。测得α约2.3，与金牛-御夫座48个空间致密盘相似；合并样本中α与250 GHz流量呈弱相关（Pearson r=0.27，p=0.02），与R95半径无可靠相关。作者认为≥200 GHz连续谱由光学厚尘埃热辐射主导，故(亚)毫米光度与视盘尺寸正相关；在约1–2 Myr星团中，较小或较暗的盘未必已耗散尘埃。这一结果对用(亚)毫米亮度推断盘尘埃质量预算和演化阶段提出警示。
papers.abstract_en: We measured the 198-310 GHz flux densities of 18 Class II protoplanetary disks in the Ophiuchus star-forming complex using the Submillimeter Array (SMA). The $\sim$200-300 GHz spectral indices ($α_{200-300}$) of these disks are $2.3^{+0.2}_{-0.5}$. In this observed frequency range, emission properties of the Ophiuchus disks are very similar to the 48 spatially compact Class II disks in the Taurus-Auriga region observed in a previous SMA survey. Combining the Ophiuchus and Taurus-Auriga samples, the Pearson correlation coefficient between $α_{200-300}$ and the flux density at 250 GHz ($F_{250\,\mathrm{GHz}}$) is 0.27 ($p=0.02$). We do not find a convincing correlation between $α_{200-300}$ and the $R_{95\%}$ radius of the disks. Our interpretation for the $α_{200-300}$ values being close to 2 in the spatially compact disks is that at $\gtrsim 200$ GHz frequencies, the continuum emission in these disks is dominated by optically thick dust thermal emission, independent of $F_{250\,\mathrm{GHz}}$ and $R_{95\%}$. As a result, the (sub)millimeter luminosity and the apparent disk size are positively correlated, which has been found in numerous resolved emission surveys of Class II disks. In young clusters with ages of $\sim$1-2 Myr, Class II disks with smaller radii or lower (sub)millimeter luminosities are not necessarily those in which the dust mass budget has been consumed or dispersed.

papers.evidence: 从数据中学习动力系统控制方程且无需候选库
papers.tldr: 从数据发现动力系统控制方程对预测与控制至关重要，但高阶方程降阶会引发候选项爆炸，数值微分又放大噪声。作者提出 Higher-Order-KANDy，将原始数据的延迟嵌入与导数“jet”嵌入结合，用按导数阶数组织的 KANDy 层堆叠学习，构建并学习延迟到 jet 的 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络映射。在含噪合成基准中，它无需候选库即可原生处理高阶系统，在最高 7.5% 噪声下每个随机种子都选出正确活跃项，而 oracle 弱形式回归会出现伪项。该工作为高阶动力学方程发现提供了抗噪且结构可解释的新路径。
papers.abstract_en: The ability to derive the governing equations of a dynamical system from data is essential for prediction and control across many scientific fields. Two challenges, however, are the expansion of candidate terms when reducing higher-order equations to first-order form and noise from estimating derivatives. We propose Higher-Order-KANDy, which addresses both problems by using delay and derivative ("jet") embeddings of the original data with derivative-ordered Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Dynamics (KANDy) layers stacked into a machine learning architecture. Compared with SINDy and WSINDy on noisy data, Higher-Order-KANDy learns governing equations without a candidate library (e.g., recovering the full-period $-\sin(u)$ with nothing named in advance), natively for higher-order systems, and holds the correct term structure as noise grows, selecting the exact active set on every seed at noise levels up to 7.5% where an oracle weak-form regression admits a spurious term, though the oracle remains the more accurate coefficient estimator. We leverage the relationship between delay and differential embeddings, along with the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem, to construct a delay-to-jet map and learn it as a Kolmogorov-Arnold network to preserve derivative structure and provide meaningful terms that appear in the governing equation. In our synthetic benchmarks, this construction recovers equations in the presence of coarse sampling and noise.

papers.title_en: Energetic Variational Deep Learning for Solving High-Dimensional Stationary Fokker-Planck Equations
papers.authors: Fanze Kong, Zhouyuan Qin, Shuangquan Xie
papers.evidence: 融入自由能变分物理约束的深度学习
papers.tldr: 高维稳态 Fokker-Planck 方程因维度灾难与密度尺度不确定而难以高效求解。该文提出能量变分深度学习框架，融合 Monte Carlo 弱监督、自由能变分物理约束与拟牛顿优化，并借助测试函数族扩展至含逐点正交旋转分量及更一般非梯度漂移的稳态系统。数值实验表明，该方法在粗糙势与噪声数据等场景下仍能稳健逼近高维稳态密度，为高维平衡态计算提供了可行、通用且有效的计算路径。
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a deep learning framework for solving high-dimensional stationary Fokker-Planck equations by combining Monte Carlo weak supervision, energy-variational physics constraints, and quasi-Newton refinement. Monte Carlo statistics anchor the scale of the stationary density, while a free-energy variational loss enforces equilibrium physics; the formulation also applies to stationary systems with pointwise orthogonal rotational components and, using a family of test functions, to systems with more general non-gradient drift. Numerical results demonstrate accurate and robust density approximations across a range of high-dimensional stationary Fokker-Planck problems, including rough-potential and noisy-data settings.

papers.title_en: Performance of AutoRegressive Planet Search methodology on simulated PLATO lightcurves
papers.authors: Eric D. Feigelson, Marco Montalto, Geert Jan Talens, Suzanne Aigrain, Luca Malavolta, Valerio Nascimbeni, Tiziano Zingales
papers.evidence: 模拟光变曲线上的系外行星凌星探测方法
papers.tldr: 为评估PLATO探测小凌星行星的灵敏度，本文在模拟光变曲线中检验ARPS流程：对LOPS2磁活动恒星注入0.5–2.0 R⊕行星，并用自回归建模与Transit Comb Filter周期图搜寻。结果在亮星前三个月数据中，周期短于40天的地球大小行星恢复率至少50%；两年LOPS2数据中，周期短于240天者恢复率25%。研究还讨论去趋势、虚警与审查，并展示PPV热图，为小行星探测可靠性提供方法学参考。
papers.abstract_en: AIM. This study examines the PLATO mission sensitivity to small transiting planets (radii between 0.5 and 2.0 R$_\oplus$) using Autoregressive Planet Search (ARPS) methodology based on simulated lightcurves.   Methods. Several thousand simulations of PLATO-like lightcurves from magnetically active stars expected from the PLATO Long Observation Phase South 2 (LOPS2) field with injected transiting planets smaller than 2.0 R$_\oplus$ radius are examined. The lightcurves are analyzed with ARPS that uses autoregressive modeling for filtering of nonplanetary signals and the Transit Comb Filter periodogram for planetary transit detection. False alarms of nonexistent periodic signals are reduced by thresholds on two ARPS parameters, peak periodogram power, and transit duration.   Results. When applied to PLATO's simulated first three months observations of bright stars (P1 and P2 samples), at least 50% of Earth-size planets are recovered for periods shorter than 40 d. In two years of LOPS2 observation, 25% are recovered for periods less than 240 d. Methodological implications on detrending, periodograms, False Alarms, vetting, and catalog evaluation are discussed. The utility of a positive predicted value heat map after detection and vetting is demonstrated.   Conclusions: While the ARPS planet detection procedure is not entirely well-suited for PLATO analysis, this study provides methodological insight into the sensitivity and reliability of small transiting planet detection.

papers.title_en: Plato benchmark stars I. The initial benchmark sample
papers.authors: T. Merle, P. F. L. Maxted, O. L. Creevey, U. Heiter, D. B. Palakkatharappi, K. G. Hełminiak, C. C. Aguilera Gómez, M. Bazot, S. Cassisi, N. Ebrahimkutty, R. E. Giribaldi, P. Jofré, F. Kiefer, M. N. Lund, N. Miller, T. Morel, D. Mourard, N. Nardetto, J. -D. do Nascimento, T. Olander, G. N. Pawar, A. Rebassa-Mansergas, R. Raddi, B. Rojas-Ayala, J. Southworth
papers.evidence: 提供精确恒星参数的基准星表以支撑系外行星刻画
papers.tldr: PLATO任务需高精度恒星参数以刻画系外行星并检验模型。本文构建PLATO基准星（PBS）目录，汇集食双星、分光双星、干涉、星震及大型巡天数据，为恒星参数标注B1/B2/B3质量等级。目录含1090颗FGKM主序与亚巨星，其中15颗金、195颗银、416颗铜样本；约40%位于PLATO视场。该目录是迄今最大基准星集合，可用于管线验证、演化模型测试与跨巡天校准。
papers.abstract_en: The ESA PLATO mission aims to detect and characterise Earth-size exoplanets orbiting bright, late-type stars using high-precision photometry and asteroseismology. Precise stellar parameters of host stars are essential for exoplanet characterisation and model benchmarking. This work defines the PLATO benchmark stars (PBS) catalogue, a comprehensive sample of well-characterised stars designed to support all mission phases. We compiled data from eclipsing and spectroscopic binaries, interferometry, asteroseismology, and large spectroscopic and photometric surveys. Fundamental and atmospheric stellar properties (mass, radius, luminosity, age, effective temperature, surface gravity, density, and limb darkening) were assigned quality levels (B1, B2, B3) reflecting their degree of model dependence. Homogenized ancillary parameters (including Gaia DR3 bias-corrected parallaxes, metallicities, bolometric fluxes, extinction, rotation periods, and X-ray fluxes for M dwarfs) are also provided. The PBS catalogue contains 1090 FGKM main-sequence and subgiant stars, divided into three quality tiers based on model-independent (B1) parameters: gold (15 stars with B1 mass, radius, and luminosity), silver (195 with B1 mass and radius), and bronze (416 with at least one B1 property). The remaining stars feature well-characterised model-dependent (B2) or empirical (B3) properties. About 40% of the sample lies within the PLATO fields of view (285 in LOPN1 and 143 in LOPS2). The PBS sample represents the largest catalogue of benchmark stars assembled to date, providing a key resource for validating automated pipelines, testing evolutionary models, and cross-survey calibration. The catalogue is available online at https://astro.ulb.ac.be/pbs and will be updated regularly.
